import html # Example template; adjust as needed for your application. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def render_blog_post(title: str, body: str) -> str: """ Render a user-generated blog post safely for web display. Parameters ---------- title : str The title of the blog post. body : str The main content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A sanitized HTML string with the title and body inserted into BLOG_FORMAT. Raises ------ ValueError If either title or body is empty after stripping whitespace. """ # Basic validation: ensure non-empty content if not title or not body: raise ValueError("Both title and body must be provided.") # Strip leading/trailing whitespace clean_title = title.strip() clean_body = body.strip() # Escape HTML special characters to prevent XSS escaped_title = html.escape(clean_title, quote=True) escaped_body = html.escape(clean_body, quote=True) # Insert into the template rendered_html = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=escaped_title, body=escaped_body) return rendered_html
